execution.raw_text:
```sql
SELECT
  md.chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  di.mesh_id,
  di.mesh_heading,
  di.efo_id AS indication_curie,
  di.efo_term AS indication_label,
  di.max_phase_for_ind
FROM molecule_dictionary md
INNER JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno
WHERE di.max_phase_for_ind = 4
ORDER BY
  md.chembl_id ASC,
  md.pref_name ASC,
  di.mesh_id ASC,
  di.mesh_heading ASC,
  indication_curie ASC,
  indication_label ASC,
  di.max_phase_for_ind ASC
```
